title: Comparing the Empirical Content of Economic Theories
abstract: arXiv:2611.02565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A fitted theory that predicts well may do so because of the structure it commits to or because it was fitted to the data it is evaluated on. We propose measures that separate the two by operationalising a theory as a functional form, a support restriction on behavior and a distribution over the parameters, with no parameter fitted to the evaluation sample. Probabilistic completeness is the share of the predictable variation that a rule drawn from the theory captures out of sample. Probabilistic restrictiveness is how much conceivable behavior such a rule excludes; it separates into what the functional form can reach and how the parameter distribution concentrates on it. The parameter distribution can be interpreted as uncertainty about a representative agent or as the distribution of parameters across heterogeneous agents, and the measures adapt to both interpretations through the choice of scoring rule, baseline and ceiling. translated_title: 比较经济理论的经验内容
translated_abstract: 一个拟合良好、预测准确的理论，可能是因为它所承诺的结构本身，也可能仅仅是因为它是在被评估的同一数据上进行拟合的。我们提出了一组度量方法来区分这两种情况，其做法是将一个理论操作化为一个函数形式、对行为施加的支撑限制以及参数上的一个分布，并且没有任何参数是针对评估样本进行拟合的。概率完备性衡量的是从理论中抽取的规则在样本外能够捕获的可预测变化所占的比例。概率限制性衡量的是这样的规则排除了多少可以想象的行为；它可以进一步分解为函数形式所能触及的范围，以及参数分布在该范围内的集中程度。参数分布既可以被解释为对代表性个体的不确定性，也可以被解释为异质性个体之间参数的分布，而这些度量会通过评分规则、基线和上限的选择来适应这两种解释。一个范围层……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“概率完备性”和“概率限制性”两个度量，通过将理论操作化为函数形式加参数分布、且不在评估样本上拟合任何参数，从而在样本外把理论的真实结构预测力与对数据的过拟合区分开来。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes "probabilistic completeness" and "probabilistic restrictiveness" measures that operationalize a theory as a functional form with a parameter distribution—fitted on no evaluation data—to disentangle a theory's genuine out-of-sample predictive structure from mere overfitting.
